name: Exa-Answer
description:
Get a quick LLM-style answer to a question informed by Exa search results. 

For more in-depth results, consider using the following endpoint: https://poe.com/Exa-Research

Supported file type upload: PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG
Audio and video file upload is not supported.

Parameter Controls Available:
- Include source text snippets. Toggle `on` to show text snippets under each source citation. This is set to `off` by default.

sources.notes: Canonical entity for an exact public Poe bot identifier returned by the models API.

verification.notes: Identity and advertised metadata verified against Poe's public models API.
